candidates.original_title: Tumour vascularization via endothelial differentiation of glioblastoma stem-like cells
candidates.description: Glioblastoma stem-like cells and U87MG cells express very low levels of the endothelial marker Tie2, whereas normal human endothelial cells express Tie2 robustly.
candidates.citation_sentence: These experiments, and others, demonstrated that tumor xenografts obtained by injection of human glioblastoma neurospheres developed an intrinsic vascular network composed of tumor-derived endothelial cells (Ricci-Vitiani et al., 2010).

candidates.original_title: Tumour vascularization via endothelial differentiation of glioblastoma stem-like cells
candidates.description: Selective killing of glioblastoma stem-like cell-derived endothelial cells with ganciclovir reduces and degenerates xenograft tumors, demonstrating that these endothelial cells contribute functionally to tumor growth.
candidates.citation_sentence: These experiments, and others, demonstrated that tumor xenografts obtained by injection of human glioblastoma neurospheres developed an intrinsic vascular network composed of tumor-derived endothelial cells (Ricci-Vitiani et al., 2010).
candidates.notes: Registered report protocol with no replication results reported; Protocol 3 tests the original xenograft/ganciclovir finding shown in Figures 4B, S10B, S10C, and S10D. Protocol 2 is a supporting transduction procedure, not a separate replication entry. The replication uses single injections and only GSC83 and U87MG cell lines.
